newsitem.title: USA: HOT STOCK HIGHLIGHTS - Corporate Earnings.
newsitem.headline: HOT STOCK HIGHLIGHTS - Corporate Earnings.

text.p: The following companies in the last day reported quarterly earnings or made results forecasts:
** International Business Machines Corp, off 7/8 to 128-1/2.
Co reported third quarter income of $2.45 per share, up from $2.30 in the year-ago period.
First Call consensus estimate was $2.43 per share.
** Molten Metal Technology Inc, off 11-7/8 to 16-1/4.
Late Sunday night, the company said it expects a shortfall in research and development revenue to hurt third and fourth quarter earnings.
The company, which plans to release its third-quarter results by November 11, said revenue from research and development that is funded by the government would not meet expectations for 1996.
** RJR Nabisco, off 1/8 at 26-5/8.
Co reported third quarter earnings of $0.66 per share versus $0.56 in ther year-ago period.
The First Call consensus estimate was $0.57 per share.
** Ametek Inc, up 1/8 to 19-1/8.
Co reported third quarter net income of $0.40 per share versus $0.25.
The First Call consensus estimate was $0.38 per share.
** Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co, up 3/4 to 46-1/4.
Co reported third quarter earnings of $1.09 per share versus $1.03 in the year-ago period.
The First Call consensus estimate was $1.09.
** Texaco Inc, up 3-5/8 to 107.
Co reported third quarter earnings of $1.61 per share versus $1.06.
The First Call consensus estimate was $1.46.
** Exxon Corp, up 7/8 to 90-1/4.
Co reported third quarter earnings of $1.25 per share versus $1.20 in the year-ago period.
The First Call consensus estimate was $1.21 per share.
-- Wall Street Desk, 212-859-1734
